summary: Satellos Bioscience Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the results of its Annual Meeting of Shareholders held June 17, 2026. The meeting included the election of directors and reappointment of auditors. All director nominees were elected with majority support; notable dissenting votes were 7.78% against Stephanie Brown and 16.24% against Iris Loew-Friedrich. Shareholder turnout was 55.3% of outstanding shares. The filing is a routine corporate governance update under Rule 13a-16, reporting standard annual meeting outcomes with no special situation such as acquisitions, activist campaigns, or strategic changes.
